desc: Ruger is proud to introduce the Fifth Edition of the Ruger Collector's Series, the National Ruger Day 10/22 Carbine. This collectible rifle features an exclusive Collector's Series bolt marking and comes packaged with a National Ruger Day commemorative metal street sign. Also included are a Fifth Edition Ruger Collector's Series bumper sticker and pin. This camo-dipped rifle features an American Camo synthetic stock and ships with one detachable, 10-round rotary magazine. The rifle also features a protected, non-glare blade front sight, host ring adjustable rear aperture sight, and Picatinny rail while retaining popular 10/22 features like the push-button, cross-bolt manual safety and cold hammer-forged barrel that is threaded 1/2"-28 to accommodate popular muzzle accessories.
